focus.product: Finish-machined iron castings for water and fire networks: valves, hydrant pillars and bodies, flanged pipe fittings and pump housings (Ceper foundry cluster)
focus.why: Kemenperin calls Ceper one of Indonesia's largest foundry centres (260 firms, 3,500 workers in 2016; Koperasi Batur Jaya had 168 members and >4,000 workers in 2019). On 16 Oct 2026, 27 firms in Kecamatan Ceper held TKDN certificates, among them gate valves and hydrant pillars (PT Baja Kurnia), flanges and dismantling joints ND50-1200 (PT Atmaja Jaya), pipe fittings (PT Aneka Adhilogam Karya), pump castings (CV Samudera Steel) and 130-200 mm crank arms and bearing housings (CV Aneka Metal Industri). Klaten's 2021-2041 industry plan names iron and steel foundry in Ceper and Jatinom as a leading industry. In 2025 Indonesia imported US$945M of valves (848180, 54% from China) and US$300M of pump parts (841391), while already exporting more cast pipe fittings (730719, US$34.3M) than it imported (US$5.7M). CNC turning and boring turns rough castings into higher-value finished parts; 3D-printed sand-mould patterns would ease the cluster's pattern-maker shortage.

also.product: Rail and engine wear parts: railway brake blocks and brake parts, cylinder sleeves and liners
also.why: Koperasi Batur Jaya supplied metallic brake blocks to PT KAI for 27 years (to 2019) and shipped 200 cylinder sleeves to a TMMIN supplier in Jan 2019. Railway-parts imports (8607) rose to US$182.4M in 2025 from US$70.7M in 2023; railway air-brake parts (860721) alone rose to US$20.3M from US$6.5M in 2024.

also.product: Maintenance spare parts for sugar and textile mills: shafts, bearing housings, gears and rollers
also.why: PT SGN plans to restart the dormant PG Tasikmadu (Karanganyar) in 2027 with modernised technology. Textiles are a leading industry in the Surakarta, Sukoharjo and Klaten plans. Ceper firms already hold TKDN certificates for large crank arms and bearing housings, and PT ATMI Solo makes precision parts. In 2025 Indonesia imported US$45.8M of food and sugar machinery parts (843890) and US$43M of spinning and weaving machine parts (844839, 844849).

focus.product: CNC-machined aluminium motorcycle parts and accessories (billet aftermarket parts)
focus.why: DTECH in Salatiga builds its own SUPERMILL CNC mills (TKDN 40.91% in 2021), had about 450 staff in Apr 2024 and trains D4 students with Akademi Inovasi Indonesia. It is linked to the ARM CNC aluminium motorcycle-parts brand (shown on DTECH's site; detikJateng in Apr 2024 called it a spare-parts company DTECH invested in), which Koran Jakarta (Nov 2025) reports sells in Thailand, the Philippines and Malaysia. Indonesia already exports US$1,169M of motorcycle parts (871410, 2025). Salatiga's 2026 UMK of Rp2.70M is under half of Bekasi's, which favours labour-heavy CNC finishing.

also.product: Brass gas valves and fittings (LPG cylinder valves)
also.why: PT Karilla Berkat Abadi in Kota Magelang holds TKDN certificates of 85-90% for LPG cylinder valves, a high-volume turned-and-assembled part.

also.product: CNC-carved and sawn building and ornamental stone (Muntilan)
also.why: Muntilan and Mungkid have 518 stone craftsmen (Undip, Jun 2024); Indonesia exported US$51.9M of worked stone (6802) in 2025, US$16.6M of it 680299. Kab. Magelang's 2023-2043 plan lists non-metal mineral products as a leading industry.

focus.product: Motorcycle exhaust systems (knalpot) and exhaust components: bent tubes, flanges, end caps, heat shields
focus.why: Purbalingga's industry plan for 2025-2045 (Perda 3/2025) names 'knalpot and automotive components' a leading regional industry and plans SNI standards, a knalpot centre and link-and-match with vehicle brand holders. The cluster had 700-1,000 craftsmen and about 250 association members (2019) and a Kemenperin-built knalpot centre at the UPTD Pengembangan Industri Logam. Production was still mostly manual in 2019, so CNC tube bending, laser-cut flanges and CNC-machined end caps and press dies are the upgrade path. Indonesia imported US$60.9M of vehicle silencers and exhaust pipes (870892) in 2025, mostly from Japan and India, and exported US$17.9M, mostly to Thailand, Viet Nam and Malaysia.

also.product: Maintenance spare parts for the Cilacap refinery, cement and power plants: pump, valve and transmission parts
also.why: Kilang Pertamina RU IV Cilacap (348 MBSD per Central Java's 2017 industry plan) applies TKDN in every procurement (KPI, Sep 2025); Cilacap also hosts an integrated Solusi Bangun Indonesia cement plant and PLTU Cilacap. Politeknik Negeri Cilacap's D3 Teknik Mesin graduates work at both RU IV and Solusi Bangun Indonesia.

also.product: Farm machinery: power threshers, rice threshers and irrigation pumps
also.why: Banyumas makers hold TKDN certificates for threshers and pumps: PT Tanikaya Multi Sarana (18 thresher certificates), CV Inafa Teknik, CV Doobu Sukses Bersama, PT Astana Wira Karya. Banyumas's 2018-2038 plan lists machinery and metal goods among leading industries; harvesting and threshing machinery imports (8433) reached US$187.5M in 2025, 77% from China.

focus.product: Agricultural machinery and its machined and cast parts: two-wheel tractors, threshers, combine harvesters
focus.why: Quick (CV Karya Hidup Sentosa) builds two-wheel tractors at 40-83% TKDN in Kulon Progo, had more than 100 CNC machines and about 3,000 staff in 2017, exported its QH-11 harvester to Senegal (2022) and runs a foundry that works with Kubota Indonesia. Arqom (Sleman), Rumah Mesin (Bantul), Bangga Karya (Kota Yogyakarta) and Tunas Karya (Sleman) also hold farm-machine TKDN certificates; YPTI in Kalasan builds CNC machining centres (46.34% TKDN); the city's public UPT rents a VMC at Rp150,000/h and a CNC lathe at Rp80,000/h, and Sleman's 2025-2045 plan names machinery n.e.c. a leading industry. Two-wheel tractor imports are tiny (870110, US$0.65M in 2025), but combine harvester imports rose 71% to US$109.2M (843351, 86% from China), so combine and thresher parts are the import-substitution target.

also.product: CAD and 3D-printed wax or resin patterns for silver jewellery (Kotagede)
also.why: DIY's 2019-2039 industry plan lists precious-metal jewellery (Kota Yogyakarta, Bantul, Gunungkidul) as a leading industry; Kota Yogyakarta's 2023-2043 plan aims to strengthen the silver centre 'through technology' in 2028-2032, and DIY's plan lists regeneration of silver craftsmen. Indonesia exported US$192.1M of silver jewellery (711311) in 2025, up 38%, 47% of it to Japan. Kemenperin's BBKB in Kota Yogyakarta already offers 3D-printed resin masters, rubber moulds, wax trees and silver casting (May 2026); a local firm (CV Acta Techno Inava) makes a TKDN-certified 3D printer, and the UPT sells solid modelling at Rp35,000/h to IKM.

PT Mega Andalan Kalasan in Sleman reports 700+ employees, 150K bed-equivalents a year and exports to 51 countries; Indonesia exported US$22.8M of medical furniture (940290) in 2025, led by Australia and Japan. DIY's industry plan lists pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and medical devices as leading industries.
